a11y-roll-reader.settings.enabled.name: Read messages aloud
a11y-roll-reader.settings.enabled.hint: Speak dice rolls and chat messages using your browser's built-in voice. This setting is yours alone and does not affect other players.
Speak the result whenever dice are rolled.
a11y-roll-reader.settings.announceChat.h: Speak ordinary chat messages and emotes as well as rolls.
a11y-roll-reader.settings.announceOwn.hi: Also speak messages and rolls that you made yourself, which confirms what was actually sent.
a11y-roll-reader.settings.announceHidden: Say that a hidden roll was made, without revealing the result. Lets you follow the flow of play when the GM rolls secretly.
a11y-roll-reader.settings.speakSpeaker.h: Prefix each announcement with the character or player it came from.
a11y-roll-reader.settings.speakFormula.h: Read the formula, for example '1 d 20 plus 5', before the result. Slower, but more detail.
a11y-roll-reader.settings.speakDice.name: Say individual dice
a11y-roll-reader.settings.speakDice.hint: Read each die that was kept, not only the total. Useful for rolls where the individual dice matter.
Say when a message is whispered
Announce that a message was private, and who it went to. Without this a whisper sounds identical to public chat, so there is no way to tell that a reply would be seen by everyone.
a11y-roll-reader.settings.voice.name: Voice
a11y-roll-reader.settings.voice.hint: Which of your system's voices to use. Changing this speaks a sample.
a11y-roll-reader.settings.rate.name: Speaking rate
a11y-roll-reader.settings.rate.hint: How quickly to speak. Experienced screen reader users often prefer a faster rate.
a11y-roll-reader.settings.pitch.name: Pitch
a11y-roll-reader.settings.volume.name: Volume
a11y-roll-reader.settings.volume.hint: Speech volume, independent of the game's other audio.
Volume for whispered messages, separate from everything else. Lower it to keep private messages quiet, or raise it so they stand out.
a11y-roll-reader.settings.delay.name: Delay before speaking (seconds)
a11y-roll-reader.settings.delay.hint: Wait before announcing a result. Set this to roughly your dice animation length if you use Dice So Nice, so the result isn't spoken before the dice land.
Immediately stop the current announcement and clear anything queued behind it.
Say the most recent announcement again.
a11y-roll-reader.keybindings.openGmPanel: Open the panel for configuring another player's speech settings on their behalf.
a11y-roll-reader.gm.menuHint: Configure the Roll Reader on behalf of a player, so they do not have to navigate these menus themselves. The player must be connected. Keyboard shortcut: Alt + Shift + R.
a11y-roll-reader.gm.firstRun: Accessibility: Roll Reader is active. To set it up for a player who needs it, use Configure Settings, Module Settings, then "Configure a Player" — or press Alt + Shift + R.
a11y-roll-reader.gm.title: Player Speech Settings
a11y-roll-reader.gm.intro: Configure the Roll Reader for a connected player. Their client applies the settings and confirms out loud, so they know it worked without having to read anything.
a11y-roll-reader.gm.voiceNote: Voices come from each person's own device, so the list here is yours. If the chosen voice is not installed for them, their browser default is used instead.
a11y-roll-reader.gm.noPlayers: No other players are currently connected.
a11y-roll-reader.speech.whisperPreview: This is how whispers will sound.
a11y-roll-reader.speech.settingsUpdated: Your game master updated your speech settings.
a11y-roll-reader.speech.preview: This is how announcements will sound.
a11y-roll-reader.notifications.unavailab: Accessibility: Roll Reader could not start because this browser or client does not provide speech synthesis. Try connecting through Chrome, Edge, or Firefox instead of the desktop application.
